resolution: Compared the migration's claimed raw-readiness ruling with the durable request record and the installed Zig 0.16 standard library. No oracle ruling requires the fork; req_3153 authorized doing the migration on a safe branch but did not prescribe preserving the 0.15 socket model. Zig 0.16 directly provides std.Io.net plus Evented backends (io_uring, kqueue, Dispatch), async/cancel, Stream Reader/Writer, and readiness/error semantics. Explained that sysx/netx are therefore a deliberate source-compatibility fork, defensible only as a temporary transition—not as a permanent migration result or a user ruling.
